Madaurensis , e,
I.adj., of or belonging to the city of Madaura (on the borders of Numidia and Gætulia, not the city mentioned in the preced. art.), Madauran: “Appuleius Madaurensis,” Aug. Ep. 49 .—Hence, subst.: Madaurensis , is, m., an inhabitant of Madaura, App. M. 11, p. 271, 20.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
